name: Hoplomachus: Victorum

categories.label: Campaign won (scion defeated)
categories.hint: Tick if your hero defeated the scion in Act IV.

categories.label: Acts completed (primuses/scion defeated)
categories.hint: Primuses defeated in acts I-III plus the scion in act IV (0-4).

categories.label: Blessings unspent
categories.hint: Each unspent blessing gives a bonus in the scion fight; record for your legacy.

winCondition: Defeat three primuses in acts I-III, then complete the goal of the Scion event in act IV to win the campaign. If your hero is ever defeated (and no blessing saves them), you lose.

endCondition.description: Campaign ends when the scion event is won or the hero is defeated

notes: family: coop-solo-campaign. No point score; difficulty level sets starting blessings. Hero legacy details are recorded on the tracking pad and are not modelled.
